description: Figure 2, titled "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot that displays the performance of four different document sources—Tutorials (blue line with circle markers), Library Documentation (red line with triangle markers), StackOverflow posts (orange line with diamond markers), and GitHub files (green line with square markers)—as a function of the number of tokens used for chunking. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," ranges from 200 to 800 and is marked at intervals of 200, 400, 600, and 800. The y-axis, labeled "Performance," ranges from 10 to 40 and is marked at intervals of 10. The performance values for each source are shown at the start (200 tokens) and end (800 tokens) of the x-axis range, along with intermediate points. The performance generally increases with token count for all sources up to around 600–800 tokens, after which it begins to decline for Tutorials and StackOverflow posts, while Library Documentation and GitHub files show more stable or slightly decreasing performance. The highest performance values are observed for GitHub files and Library Documentation near 800 tokens.
